propositions: Pre-create pending-binding intent must execute durably before any Jira create call; failure before create produces zero provider calls and item-scoped persistence failure.

After Jira returns a key, the canonical rebar-id label must be attached first, followed by optional entity property as enrichment; unsupported/permission failures are visible but cannot delete the successful issue.
Create timeout or connection loss must never trigger blind replay; observation through replay-safe identity/query seams or deferred pending record prevents duplicate creation across restart.
All lifecycle intents must execute only after their remote postconditions are proven; create-before-link, hierarchy deferral, tombstone suppression, and filtered/read-only behavior are preserved.
Keyed recovery performs zero search; keyless negative search requires both three misses and 3600 seconds conjunction; per-entry recovery failure does not stop unrelated tickets.
Cloud/DC crash-restart sequences produce exactly one remote Jira issue and converge to one confirmed forward/reverse binding without duplicates.
